items.title: UC Merced Foundation Names New Board Chair and Four Trustees, Including Three Alumni
items.summary: By Francesca Dinglasan, UC Merced November 19, 2026 The UC Merced Foundation's Board of Trustees named Proietti the new chair and welcomed four new trustees. Key Points Tracy Proietti, an entrepreneur and community leader, is the new chair of the UC Merced Foundation Board of Trustees.
